notification_reason: Point Clear recovery began: all six owner cameras were healthy in the current cycle, recovery 1 of 2. The previously alerted fault remains open pending one more consecutive all-six healthy cycle. No Jubilee is confirmed.
principal_dawn_visual_assessment_status: COMPLETED. The first after-dawn owner burst at 06:10–06:14 CDT had limited Point Clear detectability, so the principal call uses the first published dawn+20 follow-up at 06:31–06:34 CDT. All six cameras were healthy with valid three-frame bursts; five had moderate and montrose_pier_bird high detectability; no Jubilee, searching, flashlight or collecting signal was resolved. Post-dawn public live-player checks at 06:36–06:37 CDT were probably fresh and yielded scoped no-event evidence in their visible areas.

active_faults.impact: All six cameras were healthy in the current cycle, completing recovery 1 of 2. One more consecutive all-six healthy cycle is required to close the fault.

known_unknowns: No current Point Clear/Daphne bottom dissolved-oxygen profile or nearshore_contact_strip_DO measurement is available.
Observed nearshore current and observed Point Clear water level are unavailable; NGOFS2 is model guidance only.
USGS Bucks tidally filtered discharge remains stale through September 4; tide-affected raw flow is not a direct freshwater-load measure.
Coffeeville current numerical discharge/timestamp was not defensibly recovered; Claiborne is stale for live scoring.
Point Clear close beach/swash and both Fairhope beaches remain outside validated public views; Fairhope also does not show Fly Creek.
Exact capture time and total upstream delay for both probably-fresh public live sessions remain unknown.
change_summary: All six owner cameras were healthy during the 00:06–00:10 CDT cycle, beginning recovery 1 of 2 from the Point Clear partial outage. Five views had low biological detectability and `montrose_pier_bird` moderate detectability; no scoped temporal Jubilee signal appeared, but most nighttime biology remains UNKNOWN. Refreshed NGOFS2 21Z guidance is unchanged at approximately +62/+75/−109/−304 m at 1/3/6/12 hours. Grand Hotel and Fairhope live players advanced across isolated 43.857- and 43.859-second samples at 01:08–01:09 CDT. Fairhope became behind live after the samples; the visible Seek-to-live control was clicked and changed to disabled “currently playing live,” verified with a post-seek sample at 01:09:37 CDT. No searching, flashlights or collecting appeared, and water biology remained UNKNOWN in darkness. KBFM was calm and clear at 00:53 CDT. No independently dated September 14 Jubilee report surfaced.
